Messages.Author: Peacovmind
Messages.Body:
Sorry if I got the names wrong, but I'm sure you know what card's I mean :

Amaranth states:

Allows vampire to diablarize a vampire rather than sending it to Topor,
Not usable by a vampire that is going to Topor.

Query: Does this automatically allow a Diablarization or do we still have
to vote? If so, is the blood hunt still voted on?

Bum's Rush:
(Bold)DO NOT REPLACE UNTIL AFTER COMBAT. (Directed Action) Attack an
opponent's minion. You have an optional maneuver usable during this
combat.
^^^^^^^^
Since this says you DIRECTLY attack an opponent's minion, can his other
minions block? If it is meant to be realistic to life, the opponent
doesn't see it coming.... thanx....

Peacovmind

Messages.Author: Larry Harriman
Messages.Body:
Peacovmind (peaco...@aol.com) wrote:
: Sorry if I got the names wrong, but I'm sure you know what card's I mean :

: Amaranth states:

: Allows vampire to diablarize a vampire rather than sending it to Topor,
: Not usable by a vampire that is going to Topor.

: Query: Does this automatically allow a Diablarization or do we still have
: to vote? If so, is the blood hunt still voted on?

You don't vote to see if your allowed to diabolize. If you try to
diabolize, and no one gets in your way, you've diabolized. The only time you
vote is after the fact, to see if the diabolist should pay for his crime.
Neither of these things is effected in the slightest by Amaranth.

: Bum's Rush:

: (Bold)DO NOT REPLACE UNTIL AFTER COMBAT. (Directed Action) Attack an
: opponent's minion. You have an optional maneuver usable during this
: combat.
: ^^^^^^^^
: Since this says you DIRECTLY attack an opponent's minion, can his other
: minions block? If it is meant to be realistic to life, the opponent
: doesn't see it coming.... thanx....

: Peacovmind

You can block it. Just because your hunting them down, doesn't mean
they don't see you coming. It's kind of pointless for the target to block it
though (unless you REALLY don't want them to have that maneuver), but her
Toreador friend might want to step in...

Larrx...
